propositions: The baseline_advanced_at timestamp field is never read in production and causes pathological git delta churn by changing ~1,144 times across a 40-revision corpus without changing baseline values.
BindingStore.set_baseline must filter five mirrored fields, preserve keys with None values, compare stored baseline for equality, and return early when unchanged rather than unconditionally writing.
Two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must preserve byte-identical bindings.json and create no new commit.
Removing baseline_advanced_at from baseline writes reduces packed cost from 13.84 KiB/version to 2.33 KiB/version (16.8% of baseline, within the 25% gate).
Every new baseline written by set_baseline must omit baseline_advanced_at; unit tests must fail fast if baseline writes read the clock.
